description: One sea star in one lab self-righting video: GRU Noodle Tracer arm polylines (base->tip, 512-px crop coordinates) for 181 frames at 2 Hz. Polylines and per-frame context only; no image pixels.
track_id: stored association from a warm-started run over the whole recording (FusedTracker, tracker_config); a cold-start re-link of this excerpt alone gives different IDs for some arms
time_origin: time_s and frame_index count from the start of the original recording
bout_fields: Self-righting bouts from human posture labels on the 1-s grid (every second 2-Hz frame): flip_start_s = first Being-flipped sample, upside_down_start_s / right_side_up_start_s = first samples of those states, first_time_s..last_time_s = analysis window (<= 5 s right-side-up context each side), duration_s = righting time; pre_onset_frames = star frames in [first_time_s, flip_start_s) used for the pre-onset body radius R0.
